'''Toral''' was an ancient [[Coynite/Legends|Coynite]] leader, at a time when the Coynite species was veering dangerously toward extinction. He was considered the strongest and most influential member of his clan. Through a series of reforms, Toral managed to unite the Coynite species under a single leader, banish the use of biological weapons, and create the [[En'Tra'Sol]] law system. These acts led to a more stabilized civilization on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coyn]], and paved the way for future generations to come. His son, [[Arl'Toral]], followed closely in his footsteps, and brought peace to the planet.
